parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The strategy version of trending to use

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip. Useful for pagination (page number * limit)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to fetch

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The user ID of the user making the request

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Filter trending to a specified genre

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Calculate trending over a specified time range
